strings.jp: 麗しの戦乙女アイギナ
救国の戦乙女アイギナ

口より先に手の出る彼女は上官からの
覚えも悪く、大して昇進もできずに
一生を終えたという…
strings.en:
Quicker with her fists than her
mouth, she was in poor favor
with her superiors, and never
rose far in rank...

strings.jp:
戦いの中で数々の経験をした彼女は
そこそこ昇進し、平凡な人生を
送ったという…
strings.en:
Through many experiences in
battle, she was promoted
moderately and led an ordinary
life...

strings.jp:
危機に際しても常に戦場の焦点に身を置く
彼女の姿勢は賞賛され、やがて戦乙女の
名を不動のものとした…
strings.en:
Always at the heart of the
battle, even in a crisis, she was
praised, and in time made the
name Valkyrie hers for good...

strings.jp:
常に戦いを勝利に導くその功績により
彼女は戦乙女の中の戦乙女と呼ばれ
賞賛されたという…
strings.en:
Her record of always leading
battles to victory earned her
praise as the Valkyrie among
Valkyries...

strings.jp:
華麗なる彼女の武勇はやがて世に
知れ渡り、その名を知らぬ者は
いなかったという…
strings.en:
Her splendid valor soon became
known throughout the world,
and there was no one who did
not know her name...

strings.jp:
国に危機があれば、必ず彼女が現れ
その姿を見ただけで兵たちの士気は
大いに高まったという…
strings.en:
Whenever the nation was in
peril, she was sure to appear,
and the mere sight of her lifted
the soldiers' morale...
